name: recon-blocks-confirmation
notes: Task 3, missing blocks. Leave one region out over the six development regions (validation region next in the list). 200 blocks per size per region, stratified by relief; every block is an independent fill from its surroundings. Errors are over hole cells in metres; blockMaeM is per block. Neural rows are means over seeds unless named -ensemble. Paired differences are negative when the first method is better; within a region the bootstrap unit is the block (optimistic, blocks of 128 overlap), over regions the unit is the region. Drainage is read within 16 cells of a non-overlapping block subset with the masked noise floor beside it.

baselines.kriging: universal kriging, linear drift, Matern 3/2 variogram fitted on training regions, local sill rescaled to the neighbourhood, band {8: 8, 32: 16, 128: 32} cells, at most 600 points
baselines.krigingExponential: the same with an exponential variogram

model.loss: per-block mean L1 plus Laplace NLL
model.targetScale: local sigma * (1 + d / 4.0), d = Chebyshev distance to the nearest known cell
model.trainingHoles: one per window, size uniform over 8/32/128, at least 32 cells of context
model.type: U-Net width 32 over the biharmonic fill, inputs plus hole mask and distance to the nearest known cell (plus geology one-hot)

selection.rule: lowest validation MAE over 20 blocks per size in the validation region

recipe.stratification: thirds of local relief (range over the block plus 8 cells) among candidate positions of the region
